comparison.objective: Spray perfume onto a held blotter strip and place the strip cleanly on a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual target holding, bottle aiming and actuation, then contamination-free card placement.
comparison.success_condition: Full-width wet mark near the tip, strip placed on the tray without forbidden contacts, tester upright, other strips undisturbed, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: Tests coordinated spraying onto a light held target, not loose-body separation.
